questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
questions.answer: Explore new cultures

questions.question: Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: Proximity to the beach, the history of UCSB, and the fact that they spoke english such that i would have an easy time making real friends that weren't just other exchange students.

questions.answer: I found housing through my host institution

questions.answer: Off campus

questions.answer: Hard, but we were lucky to get written up on a list, and actually getting a spot.

questions.answer: it's really expensive if you don't get undergrad apartments.

questions.answer: very easy.

questions.answer: have a lot of money. make friends and have fun.
